description: Conformance vectors for H6114 over ble. Every SDK — the Rust core, its bindings and any hand-written port — must produce exactly these bytes for these arguments. The wire carries no envelope here, so a vector states `frames_hex` and no `message`. See ../README.md.

vectors.name: brightness at the top of the byte
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 2.2 — exercised on the unit, which read the value back

vectors.name: brightness 0, which goes dark without turning the device off
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 2.2 — exercised on the unit, which then reported itself on with a brightness of 0

vectors.name: colour green
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 2.3 — exercised on the unit, which read back sub-mode 13 carrying 00 ff 00

vectors.name: the scene that blinks through changing colours
music, the dynamic effect at the top sensitivity, colours left to the firmware
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 2.8 — worked out from the layout; the vendor app set this state on the unit, which reported it at `aa 05` as 13 00 64 00 00

vectors.name: music, the calm effect, colours left to the firmware
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 2.8 — exercised on the unit, which read the state back as 13 01 63 00 00

vectors.name: music, the calm effect at the lowest sensitivity, on a red the caller imposes
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 2.8 — worked out from the layout; the vendor app set this state on the unit, which reported it at `aa 05` as 13 01 01 00 01 ff 00 00

vectors.name: status: power, then brightness
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 3 — both reads exercised on the unit, which answered aa 01 and aa 04 in turn

vectors.name: read the live sub-mode
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 3 — exercised on the unit, which answered sub-mode 13 and its eight payload bytes

vectors.name: read the software version
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 3 — exercised on the unit, which answered 2.03.11

vectors.name: read the hardware version
vectors.source: docs/protocol/ble.md 3 — exercised on the unit, which answered 2.01.01
